# Bound Text Publishing

> Independent publisher of character-led fiction, practical nonfiction and word search books. Founded by author Colin Bamforth.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://boundtext.com/): the publisher's books, authors and contact details.
- [Colin Bamforth](https://colinbamforth.com/): author site with a page for each book.

## Books

- [Finn and the Secret Path](https://colinbamforth.com/finn-and-the-secret-path/): children's book, ages 4 to 8.
- [Standard Operating Silence](https://colinbamforth.com/standard-operating-silence/): international thriller.
- [Shift Change](https://colinbamforth.com/shift-change/): paramedic fiction.
- [Shift-Worker Stress Workbook](https://colinbamforth.com/shift-worker-stress-workbook/): self-help workbook for shift workers.
- [Overwhelmed by Stress? (US Edition)](https://colinbamforth.com/overwhelmed-by-stress-us/) and [Australia and New Zealand Edition](https://colinbamforth.com/overwhelmed-by-stress-au-nz/): stress-management guides.
- [Motorcycle](https://colinbamforth.com/motorcycle-word-search/), [Construction](https://colinbamforth.com/construction-word-search/) and [Fishing](https://colinbamforth.com/fishing-word-search/) Word Search: puzzle books.
